title: Make PartyB liquidation settlement reserves mode-safe
summary: Fixes the isolated-to-cross PartyB settlement reserve underflow and the takeover omission case. Reserve accounting now follows each pending settlement, while availability still applies the aggregate reserve only in cross mode.

steps.title: Sync reserve when liquidation creates settlement state
steps.why: Liquidation now records the reserve contribution for every PartyB. PartyB mode no longer decides whether the settlement is tracked.

steps.title: Track each settlement contribution by delta
steps.why: The helper reads the old partyA/partyB contribution, computes max(0, actualAmount), and applies only the delta.

steps.title: Store per-settlement reserve contributions
steps.why: The aggregate reserve needs to know how much each pending settlement contributed before cleanup.

steps.title: Keep dispute overrides in sync
steps.why: A dispute can rewrite actualAmount, so it must also rewrite that settlement's reserve contribution.

steps.title: Clear normal settlement by stored contribution
steps.why: Settlement now clears this partyA/partyB contribution to zero instead of subtracting by current PartyB mode.

steps.title: Use the same cleanup in takeover settlement
steps.why: Takeover settlement clears pending reserve contributions through the shared helper before deleting state.

steps.title: Require takeover to clear every pending settlement
steps.why: The takeover path now reverts if settledPartyBs omits any pending PartyB settlement.

steps.title: Rename the reserve invariant test
steps.why: The invariant is positive actualAmount, not whether PartyB was isolated or cross-mode.

steps.title: Cover isolated-to-cross normal settlement
steps.why: The regression test proves normal settlement works after an isolated-created reserve later becomes cross-mode.

steps.title: Cover takeover settlement and omitted PartyBs
steps.why: Tests prove takeover clears complete settlement lists and rejects incomplete ones.
